name: cable lying bench cross lateral raise
description: A lying lateral raise where each hand grips the opposite cable handle and the arms sweep up and across. It hits the side delts with constant tension.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench between two low cable pulleys and grab each handle with the opposite hand.
Start with your arms crossed over your body and a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise both arms out and up in a wide arc until your hands are about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the crossed position.
Keep your back flat on the bench and avoid swinging.
